create_callback_sync_ref_model: create a SyncRefModelCallback to synchronize a reference model with alpha mixing at configurable step intervals
create_callback_rich_progress: create a RichProgressCallback to display training and evaluation progress using Rich console panels and tables
create_callback_log_completions: create a LogCompletionsCallback to generate and log model completions to Weights & Biases or Comet at configurable frequency
create_callback_weave: create a WeaveCallback to log model predictions and scored evaluations to W&B Weave with optional custom scorers
create_callback_bema: create a BEMACallback to maintain Bias-Corrected Exponential Moving Average model weights and save the BEMA model at training end
